zh.title: 波音獲洛克希德馬丁147億美元合約 三倍增加PAC-3 MSE導引器產能
zh.summary: 波音將三倍增加PAC-3 MSE導引器產能，預計創造數百個工作崗位
body: 波音已獲得洛克希德馬丁價值約147億美元的未完成合約行動，以擴大愛國者飛彈的導引器產能。
該獎項宣佈於2026年10月5日，支援七年計畫將PAC-3 MSE導引器產能提高三倍。
波音表示，聘用及最新產能擴充已於今年早些時候開始，預計新合約將在亨茨維爾地區創造數百個直接和間接工作崗位。
波音自2024年以來已在亨茨維爾投資超過2億美元擴充導引器生產設施。
合約允許波音在最終條款談判期間開始工作，且將透過現有供應鏈提升首次良品率。

en.title: Boeing awarded $14.7bn Lockheed Martin deal to triple PAC-3 MSE seeker output
en.summary: Boeing’s $14.7bn Lockheed Martin deal triples PAC-3 MSE seeker output and adds hundreds of jobs in Huntsville.
body: Boeing has received an undefinitized contract action worth approximately $14.7 billion from Lockheed Martin to scale production and deliver PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement (MSE) seekers.
The award, announced on October 5, 2026, supports a seven‑year plan to triple production of seekers for the PAC-3 MSE interceptor.
Boeing said hiring and the latest production expansion began earlier this year, expecting the contract to create hundreds of direct and indirect jobs in the Huntsville, Alabama area.
Since 2024, Boeing has invested more than $200 million in its Huntsville operation to expand the seeker factory and modernize facilities.
The contract allows Boeing to begin work while final terms are negotiated, and includes upgrades to supplier relationships and production controls.
